art_direction: 雾水浅蓝底柔赭宽碗眼，低弧开口，轻轻右看。
composition_variation: Keep the openings broad and low, but leave a clearly visible colored bowl beneath each large black pupil. The left sits three percent lower and remains less open than the right. Both pupils connect to gently bowed upper lids and turn subtly right. Matching soft ochre bands thicken slightly toward the outer lower curves; add one slender elongated ivory glint inside each pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
